author: Arnav
problem: Read the N by N adjacency matrix of an undirected graph with vertices numbered 1 to N. For each vertex i, print the numbers of the vertices directly connected to it, in ascending order, on one line.
bug_description: Appends the 0-based column j instead of the vertex number j + 1.

comments.accurate: For each row, prints the 1-based numbers of the vertices marked as connected
comments.wrong_behavior: For each row, prints the column indices of the vertices marked as connected
comments.wrong_location: Vertex numbering verified; check each row is stripped before it's split
